newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Landslide kills boy on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.
newsitem.headline: Landslide kills boy on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

text.p: A small boy died on Sunday in a landslide on a beach on the Black Sea in Bulgaria, officials said.
But fears that 10 other people had been buried proved unfounded and there were no other casualties, a civil defence officer told Reuters.
The parents of the dead boy were being treated for minor injuries in a hospital, state radio said.
The area, near the northeastern town of Balchik, was accessible only by sea and rescue attempts were further hampered by heavy rain, the radio said.
